svg.text: Display opening 62 x 46 mm, centred 60 from the left end and 65 from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the front: drill the corners 6 mm, cut between with a fine saw, file.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four 3.4 mm holes for the display screws at 20.5 and 99.5 from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: left end, each 43.5 and 86.5 from the front.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: DC isolator: 24 mm hole centred 188 from the left end and 109 from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the front; two 4.4 mm holes 21 mm each side of it, left and right.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check the isolator maker's cut-out before cutting; follow it if it differs.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tape the face, cut slowly, deburr; clean with soap and water.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the window covers the opening with 4 to 5 mm all round; the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: hood's four tabs line up with the four small holes.
